mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yglue_plugin_instance (project_id, instance_key, ide_type, ide_version, status, last_heartbeat, last_ip, extra_info, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{instanceKey}, #{ideType}, #{ideVersion}, #{status}, #{lastHeartbeat}, #{lastIp}, #{extraInfo}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE yglue_plugin_instance SET ide_type = #{ideType}, ide_version = #{ideVersion}, status = #{status}, last_heartbeat = #{lastHeartbeat}, last_ip = #{lastIp}, extra_info = #{extraInfo}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM yglue_plugin_instance WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY last_heartbeat DESC
